# ChowZilla

> ChowZilla is a campus food delivery platform. Customers order from campus
> restaurants, riders deliver the food, and every order can be tracked live.

## Public pages

- [Restaurants](https://food-delivery-platform-gamma.vercel.app/restaurants): Browse approved campus restaurants and their menus.
- [Login](https://food-delivery-platform-gamma.vercel.app/login): Sign in as a customer, restaurant owner, rider, or campus admin.
- [Create account](https://food-delivery-platform-gamma.vercel.app/signup): Register to order food or to join as a delivery rider.

## Notes

- Restaurant and menu pages are public; cart, checkout, orders, rider, and admin pages require authentication.
- Prices are in Nigerian Naira (NGN).
